'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**The [[Greater Nile Petroleum Oil Company Tower]] in [[Khartoum]] suffers heavy fire damage during clashes between the [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] and [[Rapid Support Forces]]. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2490896-kantoorflat-van-18-verdiepingen-uitgebrand-in-khartoem (NOS)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Twenty-four people are killed and 21 more injured after a bus plunges in to a [[ravine]] in the [[Andes|Andes mountains]], [[Peru]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-66844172 (BBC News)]
*Nine [[Egyptian Armed Forces|Egyptian military]] personnel are killed or injured when a transport truck carrying [[ammunition]] overturns in [[Sharqia Governorate]], [[Egypt]]. [https://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/1/1237/508597/Egypt/Defence/Nine-military-personnel-killed-or-injured-in-truck.aspx (''Al Ahram'')]
*One person is killed and another is injured by a magnitude 5.1 [[list of earthquakes in Italy|earthquake]] near [[Marradi]], [[Tuscany]], [[Italy]]. [https://www.ilrestodelcarlino.it/forli/cronaca/incubo-terremoto-paesi-frane-utjxckds (Il Resto del Carlino)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2023 Canada–India diplomatic crisis]]
**[[Canada]] expels a top [[Government of India|Indian]] [[diplomat]] after [[Prime Minister of Canada|Prime Minister]] [[Justin Trudeau]] says there are credible allegations linking the [[government of India]] to the [[assassination]] of [[Hardeep Singh Nijjar]], a [[Sikhism in Canada|Sikh]] [[Khalistan movement|Khalistani activist]] and naturalised Canadian citizen shot to death outside a [[Gurdwara|Sikh temple]] in [[Surrey, British Columbia]], in June. [https://apnews.com/article/india-sikh-slaying-canada-indian-government-trudeau-0e0d002ed02f25df4e507a362dee2d0c (AP)] [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/09/18/americas/canada-hardeep-singh-nijjar-india-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Foreign relations of Russia]]
**[[Russia]] announces that it will withdraw from the [[Barents Euro-Arctic Council]], citing a lack of cooperation between the members of the council. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2023-09-18/russia-quits-barents-euro-arctic-council-in-spat-over-presidency (Bloomberg)]
*[[Iran–United States relations]]
**A [[prisoner swap]] takes place between [[Iran]] and the [[United States]], resulting in the release of five prisoners from each country. Under the terms of the swap, Iran will also gain access to six billion [[United States dollar|dollars]] frozen in [[South Korea]]n bank accounts. [https://www.reuters.com/world/south-korea-working-unfreeze-tehrans-funds-us-iran-detainee-deal-2023-09-18/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Hunter Biden]], son of [[President of the United States]] [[Joe Biden]], sues the [[Internal Revenue Service]], alleging unlawful disclosure of his [[tax]]es by [[whistle-blowers]] who work for the agency. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/bidens-son-hunter-sues-irs-alleges-unlawful-release-his-taxes-2023-09-18/ (Reuters)]
*Three people are taken to hospital after a [[mass stabbing]] at the [[Australian National University]] in [[Canberra]]. The attacker has been detained. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2023-09-18/three-people-rushed-to-hospital-after-anu-stabbing/102871290 (ABC News Australia)]
*Philippine [[Senate of the Philippines|Senator]] [[Risa Hontiveros]] in a [[Parliamentary privilege|privilege speech]] accuses the [[Socorro Bayanihan Services]], a civic organization based in the island town of [[Socorro, Surigao del Norte|Socorro]] in [[Surigao del Norte]], as being a cult which commits sexual violence and forces marriage on its members including minors. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/9/19/philippines-doomsday-cult-accused-of-child-sex-abuse (Al Jazeera)]
